# MRP Rule 1 - Do not powergame
You must have an in-character justification for your actions. The Research Director does not need a gun when the station's alert level is Green. The Head of Security does not need an all-access ID card at shift start when no threat is identified.
## Examples
Acceptable: - Command carrying nonlethal armaments when there is a plausible threat - Command carrying lethal armaments when there is a confirmed threat - Command carrying any equipment they start with in their rooms/lockers at any time - Taking security measures (such as bolting doors, building walls, etc) when there is a plausible threat - The Captain hiding their spare ID card in a secure location - The Captain promoting the Warden to Head of Security because there isn’t one on station - General situations where a character is reacting to information during a round in ways that makes logical sense
Not Acceptable: - The Captain granting all Command staff all-access ID cards roundstart - The Head of Personnel taking Ian to ATS roundstart because “he’s a high profile target” - Creating duplicates of high-value or unique items to hand off to others - Raising the station's alert level when the situation does not match the severity the new alert level implies (this includes maintaining these levels far past when said threats have been confirmed as no longer in play) - Bolting doors to areas to increase their security before a threat is confirmed that makes their existing security insufficient - General situations where a character is preemptively preparing for situations that have yet to happen in ways that do not make logical sense
